caption: The drawing depicts two large, rounded ceramic jugs placed side by side against a plain, light-colored background. Both vessels are rendered in shades of grayish-blue with a matte finish, suggesting a stoneware or earthenware texture. Each jug has a wide, slightly flared opening at the top with a dark, shaded interior. The jug on the left features a single handle at the upper center and is decorated with a series of blue, swirling spiral designs along the upper portion, with the number “2” incorporated into the decoration near the handle. The jug on the right has two handles, one on each side near the rim, and is similarly adorned with blue, circular spiral and fan-like motifs arranged horizontally around its upper section. Both vessels have a slightly raised base and exhibit shading and highlights indicative of a light source coming from the right, giving them a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Two-Handled Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
